summary: Prepare for your Databricks Spark Certification with our comprehensive training course. Master key concepts and techniques to enhance your data expertise.
lede: Databricks Spark training covers distributed data processing in the Lakehouse environment, from Spark fundamentals to production workflows. It is for data engineers, architects, analytics engineers, and machine-learning engineers who build or maintain data workloads, with practice in designing ingestion pipelines, writing Spark SQL and PySpark transformations, tuning queries, and configuring Structured Streaming and Delta Lake workflows.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for technical professionals responsible for architecting and maintaining high-volume data ecosystems on the Databricks platform.
modules: Spark Architecture and Databricks Lakehouse Fundamentals
Spark Core Internals and RDD Foundations
Spark SQL and DataFrame API Mastery
Data Ingestion and Medallion Architecture Design
Delta Lake and ACID Transaction Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of Python or Scala programming and basic SQL query syntax. Familiarity with data engineering concepts and cloud storage environments is recommended but not required.
